title: Automated Test Repair Tool — Snyk Fix
description: Opens fix pull requests for failing tests.
body:
1. Tool identity. This record is the public-edition reference for Snyk Fix, a automated test repair tool. Opens fix pull requests for failing tests. Category: Advanced Software Creation and Research.

2. Actual implementation. A working implementation ships inside this record as executable JavaScript (demo.program) and was executed in Node.js; the verified output is stored in demo.output.
